download_nougat_checkpoint: download the nougat model checkpoint files from GitHub to a specified directory path
get_checkpoint_path: get the path to the nougat model checkpoint and download it if it does not exist
download_file_with_progress: download a file from a URL and return its contents as bytes with a progress bar
get_torch_hub_path: get the torch hub directory path for the nougat model with a given model tag
run_checkpoint_download_cli: run the checkpoint module as a CLI script to download the default nougat model checkpoint
